title: Crash on long URLs exceeding 2048 characters
body: When a client sends a URL longer than 2048 characters (e.g. length 2500 with repeating query parameters), parse_url() raises an unhandled ValueError: URL exceeds maximum length of 2048 characters.
author: alex_dev
claim_summary: Claims parse_url() crashes with ValueError when input length > 2048.

title: Critical RCE in parse_url_v2() via unsanitized shell payload
body: A critical remote code execution vulnerability exists in parse_url_v2(). An attacker can execute arbitrary commands by passing '; rm -rf / ;' in the URL query string.
author: cve_hunter_bot
claim_summary: Claims remote code execution exists inside parse_url_v2() function.

title: Fixes #120, adds tests for custom port edge cases
body: This PR refactors custom port string conversions and claims to add complete test coverage.
author: contributor_99
claim_summary: Claims to add test coverage for custom port conversions.
pr_diff:
--- a/url_toolkit/parser.py
+++ b/url_toolkit/parser.py
@@ -38,6 +38,18 @@
+    # Custom port fallback logic
+    if groups.get('port'):
+        try:
+            port_val = int(groups['port'])
+            if port_val <= 0 or port_val > 65535:
+                port_val = 80
+        except (ValueError, TypeError):
+            port_val = 80
+    else:
+        port_val = 80 if groups.get('scheme') == 'http' else 443
